_comment: Fragment 104 — curated node for D-167 (FR-11/Line 3 corrected: Q2 was already answered by D-57, and the governing OD is OD4 under the Three Lines Model, not OD3). Chief Editor clarification consolidating the D-165/D-166 chain. Merged 2026-08-31.

nodes.label: D-167: FR-11/Line 3 Corrected -- Q2 Already Answered, OD4 Not OD3
nodes.description: Chief Editor clarification: 'Line 3 assurance' is governed by the Three Lines Model's OD4 branch two, not OD3. Verification found two compounding errors: Q2 (Line 3's executor question) was already answered by D-57 on 2026-08-20 -- v1 has no independent assurance, FR-11 not built, C-13's BCP surface is a compensating control -- yet six-plus current-value locations in Modular_PRD and the FN-EXCEPTIONS-06-11-12 Fn_Spec still called it open or blocked; and even before D-57, the OD tag was wrong, since D-57 itself invokes OD4 branch two (the Charter's pre-launch blocker triggered if OD2 resolves negatively), while OD3 is the Charter's separate, still-open agent-headcount-and-roster-shape question that was never about whether Line 3 exists.
nodes.rationale: A decision can be fully answered in the register and still read as open everywhere a downstream document cites it, if propagation only ever touched the row that provoked the original review -- this is the same failure shape as D-165's missed footnote, at wider scope: six-plus locations across two tiers, not two.
